messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	int i, n, syc = 0, t = 0, k = 0;
	string s;
	cin >> s;
	n = s.length();
	cout << s[0];
	for (i = 1; i < n - 1; i++)
	{
		t = 0;
		k = 0;
		if (i < n - 2)
		if (s[i] == 'a' && s[i + 1] == 't' && !syc)
		{
			cout << '@';
			syc++;
			i++;
			continue;
		}
		if (i < n - 3)
		if (s[i] == 'd' && s[i + 1] == 'o' && s[i + 2] == 't')
		{
			cout << '.';
			i += 2;
			continue;
		}
		cout << s[i];
	}
	cout << s[n - 1];
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
